CROSS_REPO_RETURN used source-insensitive domain detection; 30/56 members were polluted by home-domain terms.

definitions.CROSS_REPO_RETURN: Title combines a directional handover/return/parent/child/consumer signal with a domain signal that is foreign to the source repository under the governed topology.
definitions.CONTRADICTORY_HANDOVER: Title contains at least two directional lineage terms, or one directional term with at least three wave labels; this is an ambiguity candidate, not a finding.
definitions.MISSING_DURABLE_SUCCESSOR: Title signals handover/return/successor/follow-up/continuation/next-step while the frozen queue has no explicit cross-repository reference.
definitions.NAMESPACE_COLLISION: Fallback/reuse cluster for P1 multi-label or reused W### namespace. Membership is a collision candidate signal, not proof of a conflict.

next_gate.selection_policy: Select a bounded subset from the corrected specific-risk clusters before any Reader/Deep-Reader consumption; do not brute-force the 1,079.
next_gate.namespace_cluster_policy: Use only for collision/reuse exceptions after specific-risk clusters; do not read all namespace candidates.
